name: Kinuya Izzak von Leroy
original_name: 絹也・イザーク・フォン・ルロイ
source:
Arnold's cousin with no blood connection (his father is an adopted son).
Zack doesn't believe in ghosts or curses, and although he sometimes disagrees with Vincent, he's not on bad terms with him. Since he was raised as a pampered boy, he is quite naive. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%88%E8%90%BD%E3%81%AE%E5%9F%8E_%E4%B8%80%E6%9F%B3%E5%92%8C%E3%80%812%E5%BA%A6%E7%9B%AE%E3%81%AE%E5%8F%97%E9%9B%A3]Wikipedia[/url].]
